Joseph went in and told Pharaoh: My father and my brothers,

have come out of the land of Canaan.
And behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
From among his brothers he took five men and presented them to Pharaoh.
Pharaoh said to his brothers: What is your occupation?
They said to Pharaoh: Your servants are shepherds,
both we and our fathers.
Shepherds.

Joseph feeds the world.

All land, all livestock, all people, everything belongs to the king.
The same system that saves lives in famine also creates total dependence on the throne.
The Cup of provision carries the seed of bondage.
Israel is safe in Goshen now,
but they are in a land where the king owns everything and everyone.
The four hundred year prophecy is already growing its roots.
The Cup that saves will become the Cup that enslaves.

steadfast love and truth.
